narrative:
Material PL1__MCF49247 exhibits a smooth demand pattern with moderate-skew distribution (CV=0.49). 
The demand regime is characterized by 95.7% non-zero demand days and mean daily demand of 699.7 units.
Lead time analysis shows unstable variability (CV=0.71) with mean 1.66 days.

The current SAP policy (no safety stock, MOQ=1050) results in high ordering frequency (166.6 orders/year) 
and annual total cost of $8348.25.

The optimized policy recommends:
- Safety stock: 1536 units (vs. current 0)
- Order quantity: 6921 units (capacity-constrained from EOQ 22208)
- Reorder point: 2696 units
- Review period: 10 days

This reduces ordering frequency to 25.3 orders/year and total annual cost to $1440.91, 
achieving savings of $6907.33 (82.7%) while maintaining 95.0% service level.

The capacity constraint is binding: maximum storage is 8458 units, and the policy requires 
8457 units total.
warnings: Demand trend detected - consider dynamic forecasting
Lead time highly unstable (CV=0.71) - supplier performance issue

research_insights.selected_model: Combined variance EOQ with capacity constraint
research_insights.selection_rationale: The smooth demand regime with unstable lead time variability requires robust safety stock buffering. Combined variance formula accounts for both demand and lead time uncertainty. Capacity constraint forces order quantity reduction from theoretical EOQ.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Material operates near capacity boundary (100.0% utilization). Any demand increase or lead time spike could trigger stockouts. Consider capacity expansion or alternative sourcing.
